SELECT "bs"."bus_stop_id" , "bs"."bus_stop_code" , "bs"."bus_stop_name" , "bs"."service_start_date" , "bs"."service_end_date" , "bs"."available_flag" , "a"."name" AS "businessCorpName"
ORDER BY "bs"."bus_stop_id" LIMIT #{displayNum} OFFSET #{startRowNum}

SELECT COUNT("bs"."bus_stop_id") FROM "bus_stops" "bs" JOIN "line_bus_stops" "lbs" ON "lbs"."del_flag" = 0 AND "lbs"."bus_stop_id" = "bs"."bus_stop_id" JOIN "line_routes" "lr" ON "lr"."del_flag" = 0 AND "lr"."available_flag" = 1 AND "lr"."rosen_id" = "lbs"."rosen_id" JOIN "line_route_bus_stops" "lrbs" ON "lrbs"."del_flag" = 0 AND "lrbs"."line_route_id" = "lr"."line_route_id" WHERE "bs"."del_flag" = 0 AND "bs"."available_flag" = 1 AND "bs"."bus_stop_id" = #{busStopId} AND "lbs"."rosen_bus_stop_id" = "lrbs"."rosen_bus_stop_id" AND ("lr"."service_start_date" < CAST(#{serviceStartDate} AS date) OR "lr"."service_end_date" > CAST(#{serviceEndDate} AS date))

SELECT "b"."bus_stop_id" , "b"."bus_stop_name" , "b"."bus_stop_kana_name" , "b"."bus_stop_en_name" /* ・停留所の緯度,経度がNullでなければそれを設定 ・停留所の緯度,経度がNullの場合、停留所に紐づく標柱の緯度,経度を設定（複数ある場合は更新日が一番新しいもの） */ , COALESCE( "b"."latitude_longitude", "s"."latitude_longitude" ) AS "latitude_longitude" FROM "bus_stops" "b" JOIN "agencies" "a" ON "a"."del_flag" = 0 AND "a"."available_flag" = 1 AND "a"."business_corp_id" = "b"."business_corp_id" LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON ("bus_stop_id") * FROM "signposts" WHERE "del_flag" = 0 AND "available_flag" = 1 ORDER BY "bus_stop_id", "updated_at" DESC ) "s" ON "s"."bus_stop_id" = b."bus_stop_id" WHERE "b"."del_flag" = 0 AND "b"."available_flag" = 1 AND "b"."business_corp_id" = #{operatingCompanyId} ORDER BY "b"."bus_stop_id"

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "bus_stops" AS "s" WHERE "s"."del_flag" = 0 AND "s"."available_flag" = 1 AND "s"."service_start_date" <= CAST(#{excelEnd} AS DATE) AND "s"."service_end_date" >= CAST(#{excelStart} AS DATE) AND "s"."bus_stop_code" = #{stopCode}
SELECT "lrbs"."stop_sequence" FROM "line_route_bus_stops" AS "lrbs" WHERE "lrbs"."line_route_bus_stop_id" = CAST(#{lineRouteBusStopId} AS INTEGER)
